1.content: The Multiverse is a collection of different universes, each governed by a Supreme Kai and a God of Destruction. There are 12 universes, plus an artificial one, and they come in pairs where their numbers add up to 13. Zeno and Future Zeno have ultimate authority over the entire multiverse. Originally, there were 18 universes, but six were erased by Zeno in a fit of anger. Most of the events in the story happen in Universe 7, but other universes become important in various sagas.

2.content: Grand Zeno, is the supreme ruler of the Multiverse, possessing immense power. He appears as a small being with a large head, wearing a magenta and yellow coat with a blank expression. Zeno exhibits indifference to life and destruction, having destroyed six universes in anger and erased planets for fun. Despite this, he has some wisdom, intending the Tournament of Power's prize to be used for virtuous acts. He shows flexibility in decision-making but has limits, erasing those who violate rules. Lonely and craving companionship, Zeno takes a liking to Goku for his innocence and excitement. Zeno also respects others like Buu, Jiren, Gohan, and Vegeta. Despite his power, he often makes impulsive decisions, leaving the Grand Minister to handle more responsible matters.

3.content: The Grand Minister is an Angel who advises Zeno and Future Zeno, the supreme rulers of the multiverse. He enforces their decrees and welcomes guests to their palace. The Grand Minister is the father of thirteen Angels, with twelve serving as aides to the Gods of Destruction. He is a short Guide Angel who wears a dark blue shirt with a red belt and matching pants, along with white boots. Personality-wise, he is calm and polite, yet mysterious. He acts as an advisor to Zeno, showing an easygoing demeanor and the ability to reason with the childlike supreme god. Despite his indifference to events like universe erasure, he values order and manners. He can be stern when necessary but remains flexible and informal. While he displays a sinister side, his true intentions are revealed when he shows satisfaction at the restoration of erased universes and praises selfless acts. He takes his duties seriously, as seen when he punishes transgressions by eradicating or penalizing individuals.

4.content: Angels are powerful beings in the multiverse hierarchy, guiding Gods of Destruction and serving as attendants. The Grand Minister advises Zeno. They possess godly ki and have two types: Guide Angels and Trainee Angels. Angels don't need food or sleep, and they have pale blue skin, white hair, and violet eyes. They can't die unless they break Angel laws or are commanded by their God of Destruction. Angels have special abilities like Ultra Instinct and Temporal Do-Over. Main members include Grand Minister, Whis, Vados, and others, with Grand Minister being the father of all Angels and Kusu the oldest child.

5.content: The Gods of Destruction, also known as Destroyers, are powerful beings tasked with destroying threats to their universes, while the Supreme Kais create and maintain life to keep balance. Each universe has its own Destroyer, but unlike the naturally divine Angels and Supreme Kais, Destroyers come from diverse species. Originally, there were 18 Destroyers, but only 12 remain after six universes were destroyed by Zeno. Every millennium, the Kais and Destroyers meet to coordinate. Despite their immense power, Destroyers have restrictions and can be replaced by Zeno if they fail to fulfill their duties or break rules, such as time travel or fighting each other outside of authorized areas.

6.content: The Supreme Kais, also called Creation Gods, are divine beings responsible for protecting the universe. They, along with Gods of Destruction, oversee the twelve universes. Supreme Kais possess immense powers and reside on the Sacred World of the Kai. Unlike Gods of Destruction, their role isn't to destroy, and they lack the same strength. Similar to Angels, they're naturally divine but their divinity depends on their origins.

7.content: Universe 7, also called is one of twelve universes. It's where the entire main sotry unfolds, except for specific sagas. It's linked with Universe 6, forming a twin universe. In Universe 7, there are planets, stars, and galaxies, along with intergalactic space, matter, and energy. Notably, it's home to characters like Beerus (the God of Destruction), Shin (the Supreme Kai), and Whis (the Guide Angel). Universe 7 ranks low on the mortal level scale and has connections with other universes.

8.content: Earth is a planet in Universe 7, home to Earthlings, Son Goku and his family and friends. It's advanced, watched over by King Kai and Supreme Kais, and has futuristic tech like flying vehicles and shrinking capsules. Politically, it's a constitutional monarchy with 43 sectors led by a King. The currency is Zeni, and years are counted by "Ages." Despite powerful characters like the Z Fighters, many believe Mr. Satan is the strongest due to his deception. Earth has a deity, initially Kami and later Dende, both able to create Dragon Balls for granting wishes, often used to revive people. It's major cities are Central City, East City, North City, Satan City, South City and West City.

9.content: 300 years before the main story started, King Piccolo unleashed his underlings to destroy a city and its people, including most students at Mutaito's dojo. Only Master Roshi, Master Shen, and Mutaito survived. Mutaito later sealed Piccolo away but at the cost of many lives. Throughout the series, Universe 7 Earth's faces numerous threats. Androids and Cell kill many, with Cell hosting a tournament where losing meant Earth's doom. Majin Buu destroys cities, and Kid Buu annihilates the planet. Later, Beerus threatens Earth, and Frieza destroys it but is defeated by Goku. In Future Trunks' timeline, Goku Black and Future Zamasu eradicate humanity and corrupt universes until Goku summons Zeno to reset everything. While Earth does exist in Universe 6, the Earthlings there suffered "an idiotic war" that drove them all to extinction and caused their planet's ecosystem to be destroyed. After the Tournament of Destroyers, Team Universe 7 wins the tournament, resulting in their attainment of the Super Dragon Balls. Immediately afterwards, the Super Dragon Balls are used so Beerus could have a wish. Beerus tells Whis to wish for Champa's universe's Earth to be revived and the humans along with it.

10.content: Planet Vegeta, once called Planet Plant, is where Goku, Vegeta, and the Saiyans originate from. Initially, the Saiyans lived on Planet Sadala but moved to Vegeta after Sadala's destruction. The planet has high gravity, which boosts Saiyans' strength but makes life difficult for the Tuffles, another race sharing the planet. A war erupted between the Saiyans and Tuffles around Age 720. Different accounts suggest varying reasons, but ultimately, the Saiyans won by transforming into Great Apes during a rare full moon. They took control, renaming the planet after their king. Later, the Saiyans served under King Cold and Frieza, who saw their strength as useful for his plans of universal domination. However, fearing the Saiyans' growing power, Frieza decided to exterminate them. Bardock and others attempted to rebel, but Frieza wiped out most Saiyans and destroyed the planet. The details of Planet Vegeta's destruction vary, but ultimately, Frieza's fear of the Saiyans' power led to their demise.

11.content: Namek is a planet in Universe 7, home to the Nameless Namekian, Dende, and other Namekians. It was destroyed by Frieza in Age 762 but the Namekians resettled on New Namek. The planet has three suns, causing perpetual daylight. Namek's year is short, at 130 days. The Namekians have a peaceful civilization and created their own Dragon Balls. A climate disaster once wiped out most Namekians, but Guru and others survived. During the Namek Saga, Frieza attacked, leading to the planet's destruction. Surviving Namekians were relocated to Earth temporarily before settling on New Namek.

12.content: The Saiyans are a warrior race from the Dragon Ball series. In Universe 7, they are aggressive and were nearly wiped out by Frieza. Goku, the protagonist, is a Saiyan sent to conquer Earth. They are named after vegetables and hail from Planet Sadala, with immense strength due to its high gravity. Saiyans prioritize strength and power, dividing into upper and lower classes based on power levels. They live violent lives, conquering planets for wealth. The Super Saiyan legend involves Yamoshi, a noble Saiyan who tried to stop evil ones but failed. Saiyans joined Frieza's army, fearing their growing power. Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta, nearly exterminating the Saiyans

13.content: Legendary Saiyans are a rare type of Saiyan found in Universe 7 and Universe 6, appearing only once every 1,000 years. They are born with immense power and are considered demonic mutants. Unlike regular Saiyans, they can't transform into typical forms, but they have their own transformation called Legendary Super Saiyan. This transformation makes them incredibly strong, with increased muscle mass and savage behavior. Notable examples include Broly and Kale, whose hair turns spike and lime green in this form.

14.content: In Universe 6, Saiyans are still thriving and peaceful, unlike in Universe 7. They fight evil and have evolved to not need tails for battle efficiency. They learned about Super Saiyan form from Universe 7 Saiyans and Cabba became the first to achieve it. They were employed by Frost but later learned he was a space pirate. In the Tournament of Power, they fought alongside Universe 7 Saiyans but were erased when they lost. They were revived later. Unlike Universe 7 Saiyans, they never left Planet Sadala, are more heroic, and don't need tails for strength. They effortlessly achieve Super Saiyan forms, like Cabba teaching Caulifla and Kale.

15.content: Saiyans, human-like in appearance, possess enhanced strength, speed, and senses, with longer lifespans than humans. Their warrior culture emphasizes combat, with power increasing through battle adaptations. Tails, exclusive to Universe 7 Saiyans, enable Great Ape transformation but can be removed; hybrids may or may not inherit tails. They have immense appetites to fuel strength and S-Cells aid transformations like Super Saiyan. Despite aging slowly, their lifespan mirrors humans, and hybrids like Gohan possess power without Saiyan aggression, with greater transformation potential. Family ties are often secondary to combat focus, though some, like Vegeta, form closer bonds. Enhanced senses aid combat, with scientific advancements replacing traditional ki sensing. Universe 7 Saiyans transform under a full moon, with tails as their weakness. Unlike them, Universe 6 Saiyans lack tails and cannot transform into Great Apes. Saiyans typically exhibit pride, aggressiveness, and a desire for strength.

16.content: In Universe 7, Saiyans have a special ability tied to their tails: transforming into a giant ape with immense power when exposed to a full moon. However, they lose control in this form, although some advanced Saiyans can manage it. Universe 6 Saiyans lost their tails through evolution and can't transform into giant apes naturally. Both Universe 6 and Universe 7 Saiyans can achieve Super Saiyan forms, enhancing their speed, strength, and energy drastically. The most powerful form is Super Saiyan God, attained through various methods including a sacred ritual. This form grants godly ki and enhances normal forms, leading to Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan, also known as Super Saiyan Blue. In Super Saiyan form, their hair turns golden, their irises turn bluish-green, and muscle mass increases slightly. Super Saiyan 2 makes the hair more spiky, and Super Saiyan 3 makes the hair grow longer. Additionally, in Super Saiyan Blue, the hair turns blue, and in Super Saiyan God, the hair becomes red.

17.content: Namekians, also known as Nameks, are a race from Planet Namek in both Universe 6 and Universe 7. They have green skin, slug-like features, and the ability to create their own Dragon Balls. They possess heightened senses, such as exceptional hearing and sensitivity to certain sounds. Namekians can survive on just water but still enjoy eating food. They exhibit various magical abilities like regeneration, body flexibility, and the power to draw out dormant potential in others. They can also perform fusion and fission, manipulate souls, and demonstrate telekinesis and telepathy. Additionally, Namekians are skilled in controlling their ki energy. In Universe 6, Namekians also exist and a large number of inhabitants of Universe 6's Planet Namek fused with Saonel and Pilina before the Tournament of Power, giving birth to a pair of very powerful Namekians.

18.content: Earthlings, including humans, anthropomorphs, and monsters, inhabit planet Earth. Despite being among the weakest races in Universe 7, Earthlings like humans exhibit some unique traits such as varied hair colors and occasional odd features. They can also harness elements of magic. Compared to other races, Earthlings are much weaker, with some being capable of feats like destroying walls and leaping great heights. However, there are notable exceptions, termed "superhumans", who possess significant power levels and include characters like Master Roshi, Yamcha, Krillin, and Videl, among others. These superhumans often play key roles as Z Fighters.

19.content: Dragon Balls are crystalline spheres found on different planets, each with varying sizes, colors, and stars inside them. When all seven are gathered, they summon a huge Eternal Dragon, like Shenron on Earth, capable of granting wishes. However, the power of these wishes is limited by the creator's abilities and the Dragon's limitations. To temporarily surpass these limits, a wisher can sacrifice their life energy. The creator must be alive for the Dragon Balls to function, and if the dragon is destroyed, they become useless. There are other types of Dragon Balls, like those on Namek, which summon Porunga and can grant three wishes. The Super Dragon Balls, created by Zalama, have no limits and are planet-sized, capable of granting any wish, as seen when Android 17 revived universes with them after winning a tournament.

20.content: Senzu Beans are magical beans grown by Korin in Earth's Korin Tower. They possess remarkable healing properties, instantly restoring a person's physical condition to its peak. Korin often provides them to Goku and his friends to aid them in battle, but their supply is limited due to the lengthy growing process. Senzu Beans taste like fish and have a texture resembling a mix of an uncooked bean and celery. They eliminate fatigue, restore stamina and energy reserves, and provide full nourishment for up to ten days. However, overeating can cause discomfort. Senzu Beans can heal various injuries, including bruises, burns, cuts, and even regenerate lost body parts, but they cannot cure sickness or diseases.

21.content: The Time Rings, worn by Supreme Kai, allow time travel without creating alternate timelines. They grant wearers immunity to changes in their personal past. Only Supreme Kais can use them, requiring a Potara earring. Green rings signify alternate timelines, and destroying a silver ring eliminates corresponding green ones. Time Rings create dark portals for travel but return users to their original time. Goku Black defied normal usage by following Future Trunks into the past. Changes in a timeline affect other timelines.

22.content: The Potara earrings are worn by Supreme Kais and can fuse two individuals into one. They grant special privileges like using Time Rings. Fusion is permanent if a Supreme Kai is involved. Goku and Vegeta fuse into Vegito using them. Fusion lasts an hour unless a Supreme Kai is involved. In the Tournament of Power, Caulifla and Kale fuse into Kefla. Fusion greatly boosts power and combines personalities. Compatibility affects fusion success. Fusion can lead to a new body and personality. Potara Fusion lasts longer and fuses clothing. Weaknesses include limited duration without a Supreme Kai, inability to power down from transformations, and potential strain on the body. Immortal and mortal fusion can lead to impaired regeneration.

23.content: The Fusion Dance is a technique Goku learns from the Metamorans, allowing two individuals to merge temporarily into a stronger being. Goten and Trunks use it to become Gotenks. To perform it, they must mimic each other's poses perfectly. A successful fusion multiplies their power, but if done wrong, it results in a weaker, obese, or skinny character. The fused being wears a specific outfit, usually wearing a open, short vest over their bare chest. Fusion lasts about 30 minutes, depending on energy usage, and there's a cooldown period before they can fuse again. The more powerful the fusion, the shorter it lasts.

24.content: The Dragon Radar, a device in the Dragon Ball series, helps find the Dragon Balls easily. It was created by Bulma but others like Emperor Pilaf and the Red Ribbon Army also have similar devices. Dragon Balls emit a signal that the radar detects, showing their location with arrows. Pressing a button zooms out for a detailed map. However, it can't always find Dragon Balls, such as when they're hidden in special containers or surrounded by certain metals.

25.content: The Time Machine, made by Future Bulma, allows travel to the past or future. It creates new timelines when used, so altering the past doesn't change one's present. It has limited power and can only make two trips before needing recharging. Using it breaks universal laws, as noted by Jaco, Beerus, and Whis. Future Trunks used it to warn about androids but couldn't change his timeline. Later, he used it to assist Z Fighters and sought help in the past during a Goku Black attack. However, he lacked fuel for a return trip.

26.content: Ki is a life force energy used by most beings, often seen as auras, shields, rays, energy blasts, or even weapon-like forms. Users with good ki control can sense its location, amount, and type, especially when enemies are strong and nearby. It can be used for healing, flying, and complex techniques. Ki is also known as "latent energy" or "fighting power" and is essential for strength, speed, and endurance. Training increases ki, and the amount correlates with power level. Maintaining balance between body and spirit enhances ki projection. There are different types of ki: Regular or Good ki: Used by those with no evil intentions, often seen as a white aura. Some techniques like the Spirit Bomb require this type of ki. Evil ki: Manifested by beings with evil hearts, often purple or pink in aura. Godly ki: Used by godly beings, superior to regular ki but can be surpassed by immense regular ki, as seen with characters like Jiren. God of Destruction ki: Special to Gods of Destruction, with a purple aura and the Hakai allows them to disintegrates almost everything.

27.content: Universe 6 is one of the twelve universes in Dragon Ball. It's almost identical to Universe 7 and shares many planets. Earth in Universe 6 was devastated by war but revived by Beerus. Planet Sadala, destroyed in Universe 7, still exists in Universe 6. It ranks low in mortal levels but is restored after being erased in the Tournament of Power. Champa is its God of Destruction, Fuwa its Supreme Kai, and Vados its Angel. Notable beings include the time-stopping assassin Hit, the deceitful Frost, and the Saiyans Cabba, Caulifla, and Kale.

28.content: Universe 11 is one of the twelve universes, filled with planets, stars, and many galaxies. It's paired with Universe 2, making a twin universe, and ranks fifth in mortal level. In the Tournament of Power, Goku and Frieza from Universe 7 knock off Jiren, leading to Universe 11's erasure until Android 17's wish restores it and its inhabitants. Belmod is its God of Destruction, Khai its Supreme Kai, and Marcarita its Angel. Belmod and Khai work well together, and Marcarita is more involved than other Angels. Their strongest warriors, The Pride Troopers, are led by Toppo, a candidate for Universe 11's God of Destruction. Members include the superfast Dyspo and the powerful Jiren, who surpasses almost everyone, even their own God of Destruction.

29.content: West City, located in region 29 on Earth, is a large metropolis known for being the hometown of Bulma and housing the Capsule Corporation headquarters. After the battle against the Saiyans, the surviving members of the Dragon Team are taken to Wukong Hospital in West City. Goku and Beerus engage in their first fight in the city before moving outside to a nearby jungle. Additionally, the Briefs family owns a beach resort located one thousand miles south of West City, which was built by Bulma for Vegeta and Goku's training.

30.content: Satan City, once known as Orange City, got its name changed to honor Mr. Satan after he claimed victory over Cell in the Cell Games. Gohan and Videl, along with their friends Sharpner, Erasa, and Angela, attended Orange Star High School there. Gohan, using his superhero alter egos Gold Fighter and Great Saiyaman, fought crime in the city. Despite being far from the mountains according to Erasa, Satan City is close to Grandpa Gohan's House for flying fighters like Gohan. The city's main street hosts the Satan City Bank, often targeted by robbers. Another notable feature is the Satan Tower, where Gohan reluctantly went on his first date with Angela.

31.content: Mount Paozu is where Goku grows up with his grandpa Gohan and encounters various monsters like dinosaurs. After Goku accidentally kills his grandpa and meets Bulma, he leaves the mountain. He returns briefly to pack before moving in with Master Roshi. As he grows up, Goku settles there with his wife Chi-Chi and sons Gohan and Goten. Eventually, Gohan's family also lives there.

32.content: Korin Tower is where Korin lives on Earth. It stands tall in the Sacred Land of Korin. Goku once spent three days climbing it to get Sacred Water. The tower honors a hero, though it's unclear who. Korin grows Senzu Beans there, which he freely gives to the Dragon Team, usually through Yajirobe. Master Roshi took three years to reach the top, while Goku managed it in three days. The water itself is just tap water, but climbing the tower builds strength. It's made of sturdy material, as even Mercenary Tao struggled to damage it.

33.content: The World Martial Arts Tournament, also called the World Martial Arts Championships, happens annually on May 7th. It started as a festival at a temple, now its venue. Initially every 5 years, it switched to every 3 years. The tournament features Earth's strongest fighters, including the Dragon Team. The winner gets a cash prize, starting at 500,000 Zeni and later increased to 10 million Zeni. Rules forbid killing, weapon use, protective gear, or teams. Disqualification results from rule-breaking. The tournament consists of preliminaries and the main event. Preliminaries include mini-tournaments indoors without an audience. Later tournaments featured a punching contest to reduce injuries. The final winner faces the returning champion. Matches follow a tree diagram format, leading to the final bout. The tournament venue includes various buildings like a dining hall, nurse room, preliminaries grounds, room for contestants, and the World Tournament Stadium where main fights happen.

34.content: Orange Star High School is where Gohan studied at 17 in Satan City, as his mom Chi-Chi felt home-schooling wasn't enough. The school's name stems from the city's original name, Orange City, changed to Satan City after Mr. Satan was mistakenly credited with saving them from Cell. Although the city's name changed, the school kept its old name, maybe to honor its past. The school has four floors and a roof that Gohan often uses during his time as the Great Saiyaman.

35.content: The Lookout is an ancient platform in geostationary orbit above Korin Tower on Earth. Initially possessed by Kami, it's a place where events on Earth and battles in the universe can be observed. Later, Dende takes over after Kami merges with Piccolo, making it Dende's Lookout, where he lives with Mr. Popo. The Lookout is in the Heavenly Realm, connected to the Divine Sage Realm where Sacred Water and previous Earth guardians' graves are found. Goku trains here for three years to fight Piccolo Jr., and others like Krillin and Tien Shinhan prepare for battles under Kami's guidance. It serves as a refuge for the Dragon Team after battles, but faces damage during conflicts like the Majin Buu Saga, being obliterated by Super Buu and later restored by the Namekian Dragon Balls. The Lookout has a secret entryway which leads to the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.

36.content: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is a special place outside Universe 7, accessible through doorways like the one at Kami's Lookout. Time inside moves much faster compared to the outside world. When entered from Earth's Lookout, one year inside equals one day outside, with intense gravity and thinner air. Variants exist, like the Galactic Patrol's, allowing three days inside for one day outside, and Frieza's, offering ten years' worth of training inside. There's also a room where time moves differently, with one day outside equaling a year inside. Gotenks fought Super Buu there, but Piccolo destroyed the door to trap Buu, himself, and Gotenks. Buu escapes, and the room can be used for up to 48 hours outside, with a myth about eternal entrapment if exceeded. Food scarcity limits to two people at a time, but more can enter. Dende rebuilds the room for Goku and Vegeta to train for a tournament against Universe 6.

37.content: Kame House, the distinctive house on a small island, was home to Master Roshi, Krillin, and others. It is painted pink, with a red roof, and the words "KAME HOUSE" are displayed prominently on the front of the upper story. It served as a training site for Goku and friends, notably for practicing the Kamehameha technique. Over time, it became more of a hideout as the Dragon Team used The Lookout as their main base. Inside, there's a main room, kitchen, toilet, and bedroom. The house, designed to withstand tsunamis, is easily relocatable via capsules. Currently, it's inhabited by Master Roshi and Turtle, as Krillin and his family have moved to Satan City. During the King Piccolo Saga, the house is moved to evade enemies but is eventually found.

38.content: Capsule Corporation, led by Dr. Brief, Bulma's father, is known for its invention of Hoi-Poi Capsules. The company, based in West City, also serves as the Brief family's residence. The headquarters has multiple floors, including a basement and an Atrium where animals roam freely. It houses various facilities like a Sparring Arena and Dr. Brief's lab. Notably, it contains a storage room where Bulma discovers the Two-Star Ball and a secret underground basement where Future Bulma builds a Time Machine. As a leading company, Capsule Corporation is renowned for its DynoCaps technology, making it rich and influential. It competes with Red Pharmaceuticals, eventually surpassing them. Besides capsules, the company produces vehicles and other items, and it's responsible for crafting essential tools for the Dragon Team, such as spacecraft, a Time Machine, and Gravity Machines. Due to their ties with alien visitors and encounters with Saiyans, the Brief family gains access to advanced alien tech, which they reverse-engineer for various purposes. The Capsule Corporation logo, simple yet recognizable, symbolizes its products and is worn by its workers. Dr. Brief, unbeknownst to himself, is revealed to be the world's richest man, showcasing the company's immense success.

39.content: Capsules were invented by Dr. Brief from Capsule Corporation to shrink objects for easy transport. They're sold worldwide with prices varying based on contents, and objects can be adapted to fit inside. The Z Fighters frequently use capsules to protect Dragon Balls and Earth. The Red Ribbon Army has its own capsule line, likely due to rivalry with Capsule Corporation.

40.content: Gohan's family includes Videl, who moved in after marrying Gohan, and their daughter Pan. Pan was born a few months after the battle with Beerus. They live in a mansion in Satan City, a gift from Mr. Satan. Sometimes, Mr. Satan looks after Pan with Videl's supervision. Piccolo is seen babysitting Pan occasionally. Goten and Trunks visited Gohan's house to give Videl a wedding present.

41.content: Vegeta and Bulma reside in Capsule Corporation in West City with their family. Vegeta, the proud Saiyan Prince, is married to Bulma and they have two children, Trunks and Bulla. Bulma, a multimillionare and brilliant scientist, is the daughter of the Capsule Corporation CEO, Dr. Brief. Trunks, their son, is a half-Saiyan warrior who has fought alongside his family. Bulla is their youngest daughter. Dr. Brief, Bulma's father, is a brilliant scientist who has aided the Dragon Team, while Mrs. Brief is his wife.

42.content: Krillin's House in Satan City is where Krillin, Android 18, and their daughter Marron reside. Krillin works as a policeman, while Android 18 takes care of the household. Although Android 17 is part of their family, he doesn't live with them. They often assist Goku and others when there are problems.

43.content: Goku's house, where he lives with his family, was bought by the Ox-King after the 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament. It's a spacious place where Goku, Chi-Chi, and Goten reside, since Gohan moved out after marrying Videl. The house has a kitchen, bedrooms, and an outdoor bathtub made from a steel barrel over a fire. The Ox-King often visits the family there.

44.content: In Universe 6, Planet Sadala remains intact, unlike its counterpart in Universe 7, which was destroyed due to internal conflict among the Saiyans. Cabba, a Saiyan and member of the Sadala Defense Forces, hails from this planet, which is ruled by King Sadala, known for his strong and proud demeanor akin to Vegeta's. The Sadala Defense Force, part of the Sadala Army, safeguards the planet, but they tend to avoid clashes with Caulifla's gang due to her formidable strength. The Saiyans of Universe 6 differ significantly from those in Universe 7. They've never left Planet Sadala and are regarded as noble heroes. Unlike their Universe 7 counterparts, they've evolved to no longer possess tails, which are no longer necessary for accessing their full strength or transforming into Super Saiyan forms. Surprisingly, they effortlessly achieve Super Saiyan forms, including Super Saiyan 2, with considerably less effort than Universe 7 Saiyans.

45.content: Beerus' Planet, also known as Beerus' Castle, is the home of the God of Destruction, Beerus, and his attendant, Whis. It's located in a realm separate from the living world and the Other World, making it unreachable by normal means. The planet resembles an upside-down square pyramid with a giant dead tree on top, housing various buildings. Surrounding the temple are animals and a large lake with diverse sea creatures. Beerus wakes from a long slumber and, with Whis, tracks down Goku, the warrior who defeated Frieza. Whis later trains Goku and Vegeta on this planet. Currently Whis and Beerus live on that planet, in addition to Broly, Cheelai and Lemo, who, along with Goku and Vegeta, usually spend time there as guests.

46.content: The Dragon Team is Earth's strongest warriors, formed during Goku and Bulma's quest for the Dragon Balls. They defend Earth and have no official leader or positions, but share a sense of justice. Known as the Z Fighters, they gather from time to time to battle enemies and protect their home. Over the years, they've added former enemies and new heroes to their ranks, overcoming powerful foes together. The main members or allies of the Dragon Team include Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan, Krillin, Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu, Android 18, Android 17, Goten, Trunks, Future Trunks, Master Roshi, Majin Buu and more. Supporting characters like Bulma, Shin, and Dende also play crucial roles in aiding the team with their intelligence, mystical abilities, and healing powers respectively. During the Tournament of Power, Team Universe 7 was primarily made up of Z Fighters.

47.content: Team Universe 7, led by Beerus, Shin and Whis, gathers the strongest fighters of their universe. In the Tournament of Power, they expand to 10 members, including Goku, Gohan, Vegeta, Piccolo, Krillin, Master Roshi, Tien Shinhan, Android 18, and Android 17. Frieza joins last minute due to Majin Buu's absence. Goku, Frieza, Vegeta, and Android 17 stand out, with Gohan as captain. In the final battle against Jiren, Android 17 emerges as the last fighter standing, winning the tournament. He uses the Super Dragon Balls to revive all erased universes and their inhabitants.

48.content: The Frieza Force was a dominant organization in Universe 7, led by Frieza. They enslaved powerful races like the Saiyans, using them to conquer planets for sale. Among Frieza's loyal followers were notable soldiers like Zarbon, Dodoria, and the elite Ginyu Force. Events such as the destruction of Planet Vegeta, the arrival on Namek to obtain the Dragon Balls, and the subsequent defeat by Future Trunks showcased the Force's power struggles. Following Frieza's defeat on Namek, he was revived and augmented with cybernetic parts by his father, King Cold. Frieza's return to seek revenge led to confrontations on Earth, resulting in his final defeat by Trunks. However, Frieza was later resurrected after a prolonged absence, aiming to rebuild his empire. In the aftermath of the Tournament of Power, Frieza was revived once again, vowing to restore his dominion. His forces encountered Broly, a powerful Saiyan, whom they later sought to use for their revenge. This set the stage for Frieza's return to power and his ongoing quest for vengeance.

49.content: Androids are robotic or cyborg beings, primarily created by the evil RR scientist Dr. Gero. Most possess unlimited energy and eternal life. They lack detectable aura, making them hard to track, except for Cell, Dr. Gero's ultimate creation. Initially designed to kill Goku, many androids turn good or are destroyed. In one timeline, they succeed in world destruction. There are different types of androids: Infinite Energy Models (like #8, #16, #17, and #18), Energy Absorption Models (like #19 and #20), Biotechnological Types (like #8, #13, #17, #18, and #20), Mechanical Types (like Major Metallitron, #8, #13, #14, #15, #16, and #19), and Bio-Androids (like Cell and the Cell Juniors).

50.content: The Other World, known by various names like the Underworld or Netherworld, is the afterlife where beings go when they die and where higher deities reside across different universes. Heaven and Hell are the primary destinations, with a level in between containing personal planets of deities and celestial bureaucracy, including figures like King Yemma who oversee day-to-day activities. Time moves differently there, making techniques like Super Saiyan 3 easier to use. Deceased warriors use less energy, and some, like Goku and the Dragon Team, retain their physical bodies, while others, like Frieza, are held in a cocoon due to their evil souls. Many souls are cleansed and reincarnated into new lifeforms in the living world.

51.content: Whis serves as the Guide Angel Attendant for Universe 7's God of Destruction, Beerus, and he's also Beerus' Martial Arts teacher. He's part of a group of angels led by the Grand Minister and is bound to serve Beerus, rarely leaving his side. Whis has a unique appearance with pale blue skin, white hair, and violet eyes. He's calm and peaceful but can be absent-minded and eccentric, especially when it comes to food. Whis is insightful and caring, often remaining composed even in extreme situations. He values etiquette and manners, showing respect to everyone around him. Despite his carefree demeanor, he takes pride in teaching and is concerned about the well-being of Universe 7. However, he maintains a facade of indifference in accordance with angel laws. Although Whis enjoys food and company, he's also dedicated to his duties. He protects his students, Goku and Vegeta, and demonstrates his power when necessary, such as holding off Broly. His actions are guided by both his responsibilities and his personal relationships, like his friendship with Bulma and his bond with her sister Vados. Whis is the most powerful being in Universe 7.

52.content:
Beerus is Universe 7's God of Destruction, with Whis as his teacher. He has a twin brother named Champa, who serves as the God of Destruction for Universe 6. Beerus is a purple cat-like creature with golden eyes, large ears, and a thin, bony body. He wears black, blue, and gold Egyptian-style clothing similar to Whis'. 

He's a powerful yet lazy god, shares many traits with cats, such as long sleep sessions and grooming habits. Despite his godly status, he shows dominance and indifference to death. He can be selfish and easily angered, especially over trivial matters like pudding. While arrogant, he shows some restraint and even humor, particularly around Goku and his friends. Despite his power, he cares for Earth and its inhabitants since he loves their food. Beerus even shows benevolence and politeness at times. Beerus has a complex relationship with others, tolerating evil beings like Frieza but also showing respect for powerful opponents. He fears Zeno and values his own life linked to Shin, the Supreme Kai. Despite their strained relationship, he ultimately acts in the interest of the universe's balance, even at the cost of erasing threats like Zamasu.

53.content: Shin rules the eastern area of the universe and is the Supreme Kai of Universe 7. Shin is short, pink-skinned with a white mohawk and dressed in a posh Kai outfit. He also wears a pair of yellow Potara earrings. Initially mysterious and powerful, his demeanor changes after the awakening of Majin Buu. Despite his wisdom, he lacks knowledge about crucial aspects of the universe due to incomplete training and isolation. He remains unaware of significant abilities like Ultra Instinct and the Potara fusion. Additionally, he shows ignorance about the Dragon Balls and Super Saiyans. Despite prioritizing morality, he struggles to understand Saiyan behavior. He has a strained relationship with Beerus but ultimately upholds his duties as a Supreme Kai. Prior to his current role, Shin was an apprentice to the old Supreme Kai. He survived Majin Buu's onslaught with the help of Grand Supreme Kai but later destroyed Bibidi to avenge his fallen comrades. With a new bodyguard named Kibito, he continues his peaceful life on the Sacred World of the Kai.

54.content: Kibito is the Attendant Supreme Kai of Universe 7, characterized by his tall blue-skinned appearance. Initially skeptical of mortals like Gohan, he later acknowledges their strengths. Despite some distrust, he fulfills his duties, aiding Supreme Kais with magical abilities. After many Supreme Kais were killed by Majin Buu, Kibito became Shin's bodyguard. He accompanies Shin to the World Martial Arts Tournament where he fights Gohan and aids him against Babidi's minions. Later, he is killed by Dabura but revived with the Dragon Balls. Kibito doubts mortals' capabilities but is proven wrong when Gohan wields the Z Sword. He helps Gohan unlock his powers and even makes him a new outfit. Accidentally fusing with Shin into Kibito Kai, he later separates with the Dragon Balls.

55.content: Old Kai, also known as Elder Kai or Great Kaioshin, is a fusion of the Old Witch and the Supreme Kai. Despite being lecherous and self-centered, he possesses wisdom and occasionally shows sacrificial tendencies. He wears a typical Kai outfit, is purple-skinned with white hair, and has a toothbrush mustache. His personality is perverted, akin to Master Roshi, enjoying dirty magazines and even accepting bribes for them. However, he is also knowledgeable and instructs Goku and Vegeta in Potara Fusion. Old Kai is skilled in magic, especially in unlocking potential. He performs a ritual, lasting for hours, to unlock Gohan's hidden power, which frustrates Gohan but demonstrates Old Kai's unique abilities. He was sealed in the Z Sword by Beerus during an argument long time ago.

56.content: King Kai, ruler of Universe 7's North Area, mentored Goku in martial arts, teaching techniques like the Kaio-ken and the Spirit Bomb. He also had disciples like Krillin, Yamcha, Piccolo, Tien, and Chiaotzu for a time. Despite his eccentricities, he's highly intelligent and strategic, aiding during crises like the Frieza Saga. He died when Cell exploded and remains dead. King Kai enjoys teasing and bickering with other Kais and resides on his own planet at the end of Snake Way, where he enjoys driving his Red 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air Hardtop. The planet was destroyed by Beerus after losing in hide and seek, and King Kai rebuilt it smaller for his enjoyment.
